offers_products.reason: Manufactures electric power steering, steer-by-wire, driveline systems, steering columns, plus MotionIQ software for automakers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured steering and driveline components; engineering and software development support is tied to product programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells only to automakers such as BMW, Ford, GM, Stellantis, VW, BYD; not to individual drivers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are automotive OEMs including GM, Ford, Stellantis, VW, BMW, BYD, Chery, Geely.

recurring_revenue.reason: Supplies steering systems to automakers under multi-year platform programs with repeat production-volume orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand follows new vehicle production, which automakers and car buyers cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Sells components shipped in high-volume, frequent production releases; individual parts are low-value per unit, though programs are long-term.

people_delivered.reason: Customers buy manufactured steering and driveline hardware and software, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large global automakers such as GM, Ford, Stellantis, VW, BMW and BYD.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs multiple manufacturing plants worldwide plus technical centers; heavy manufacturing needs ongoing capital investment.
